_comment: CastaliaB: config/castalia.json with hart 0 turned all the way up. The chip shape, peripheral set, memory map and package are byte-for-byte Castalia's; the only difference is the orchestrator's ISA and privilege set, which carries every selectable isa.* extension plus U-mode and PMP at the shipped 16 entries, so the soft centre hart is the one that runs anything the tiles cannot. isa.minimalTiles stays true, so harts 1-4 keep dropping M and B and stay rv32iac at their M/B seam -- note that the generator's tile split covers ONLY M and B, so the Z extensions and the privilege knobs below reach the hardened tiles too (TILE_ENABLE_* has three members; everything else is CORE_ENABLE_*). Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/castalia_b.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_b.json
